bias.zh: 反弹 · 跌破 $382，仍高于 10 日均线

read.en: Applied Materials fell 3.6% on Nov 12 to $380.95, trading $376.25–397.20. It is above the rising 5-day ($370.4) and the 10-day ($368.7) and below the 30-day ($422.9), 100-day ($490.1) and 200-day ($446.4); the 5-day and 200-day are rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 11, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($318.71), and RSI is 44.7.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月12日下跌 3.6%，收于 $380.95，盘中区间 $376.25–397.20。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$370.4）和 10 日均线（$368.7）上方，30 日（$422.9）、100 日（$490.1）和 200 日均线（$446.4）下方；5 日和 200 日均线在上行。MACD 于 11月11日上穿信号线，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$318.71），RSI 为 44.7。

read.en: The $397.20 high stalled under $399–405 and the close lost the $381.75 Nov 11 low, now resistance; the $376.25 low held. Resistance is $381.8–390.1 (Nov 11 low, Oct 30 close), then $397.2–404.7 (Nov 12, Nov 2 and Nov 11 highs) and $411.5. Support is $368.7–376.3 (10 and 5-day), then $343 and $317–318.7. A close above $390.1 would target $397–405; below $368.7, $343.

r.en: Nov 12 high $397.20; Nov 2 high $399.19; Nov 11 high $404.71
